purpose: Historical frontend context only; not a prediction or model input.
person_identity: Use the upstream persistent person_id; never match by name.

history_scope.returning_councillor: A candidate with a strictly earlier council victory who is not a council incumbent immediately before the subject election; prior ward is irrelevant.
history_scope.combined_prior_elected_office: At least one confirmed prior non-council victory, or Returning councillor.

temporal_rule.most_recent: Maximum election_date among qualifying prior Candidacies.

margin_rule.unit: Vote-share proportion; catalog estimates convert effects to percentage points.
margin_rule.own_non_council_value: Margin from the most recent qualifying prior non-council Candidacy.
margin_rule.opponent_non_council_value: Maximum of each opponent's most recent qualifying non-council margin.
margin_rule.own_combined_value: Margin from the latest qualifying non-council Candidacy or, for a Returning councillor only, prior council Candidacy. Latest is chosen by election_date.
margin_rule.opponent_combined_value: Maximum of each opponent's own_combined_value; sitting incumbents' prior council results are excluded.

continuous_display_rule.own_margin: Fire only when most_recent_prior_elected_margin is not null.
continuous_display_rule.opponent_margin: Fire only when strongest_opponent_prior_elected_margin is not null.
continuous_display_rule.victory_count: Fire only when prior_elected_candidacy_count > 0; zero is valid only after a confirmed qualifying prior Candidacy.
